mechanism: Duloxetine is a serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor that increases serotonergic activity, and when combined with prochlorperazine (a typical antipsychotic with some serotonergic properties), there is increased risk of serotonin syndrome; additionally, both drugs have anticholinergic and CNS depressant effects that are additive.
action: Monitor for signs of serotonin syndrome (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, rigidity) and excessive CNS depression; use lowest effective doses and consider alternative antiemetics if serotonin syndrome symptoms emerge.
